title: ReplayRequestedPayload
description: Payload of the ReplayRequested platform event (INV-REQ-1226 b1-b2, coordinator ruling INV-Q-3674; class: platform), the replay request of INV-REQ-1205 b4 (owner ruling INV-Q-3599 A, INV-API-3654). A consumer's rebuildConsumer writes it to the consumer's own outbox in the transaction that moves its positions to the head; its relay publishes it on gst.<consumer>.replay-requested.v1, which every producer the consumer subscribes to reads; only the addressee named in producer acts on it. Stored under the platform TenantId and published without tenantid or entityref (INV-REQ-1226 b7); a scope's tenant travels in the payload. The requesting consumer is the CloudEvents source. Authored by INV-T-3634. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4).

replayId.description: New per request; returned by rebuildConsumer and echoed by the ReplayCompleted that answers it (INV-Q-3644).

producer.description: The addressee: the pair's catalogue producer value in event-log/topics.yaml, a service name or 'every service' (INV-Q-3625).

mode.description: SCOPE for a replay by scope, FULL_SYNC for a full sync (INV-REQ-1205 b4). Extensible (API-09, API-41).

ReplayScope.description: The scope of a replay by scope (INV-REQ-1205 b4), present only when mode is SCOPE; a tagged union on kind (owner ruling INV-Q-3671): TENANT {tenantId}; ENTITY {tenantId, entityRef}; PERIOD {from, to, tenantId?}, a half-open range [from, to) on the time the producer's state was last changed, across all tenants unless narrowed by tenantId.

kind.description: Which scope shape this is (INV-Q-3671). Extensible (API-09, API-41).

tenantId.description: The tenant; required for TENANT and ENTITY, optional for PERIOD (narrows it to one tenant).

entityRef.description: The registered entity; required for ENTITY.

from.description: PERIOD only: inclusive start of the range on the time the producer's state was last changed.

to.description: PERIOD only: exclusive end of the range; later than from.
